summary: The candidates ride home through the night. Reiner faces his mother and the warrior unit. Gabi's pride fills the car. Falco watches what the return costs.

segments.ja: 装甲を割った子供たちは、本土へ戻る列車に乗っています。乗っている車両は、夜の真ん中です。真ん中の窓の外は、戦場の火がもう小さいです。小さい火を、ガビは自分の勝ちとして話します。話す声が、車両の灯を占めています。占めているあいだ、ファルコは席で目を閉じます。閉じる理由は、疲れと、彼女の点数を聞きたくない気持ちです。気持ちの横で、車輪が一定の音を刻みます。
segments.en: The children who split the armor are on the train returning to the home country. The car they are on is the middle of the night. Outside the window of the middle, the fires of the battlefield are already small. Gabi talks about the small fires as her own win. The voice that talks occupies the lamp of the car. While it occupies it, Falco closes his eyes in his seat. The reason he closes them is fatigue, and the wish not to hear her points. Beside the wish, the wheels cut a steady sound.

segments.ja: ガビは、継ぎ目へ走った距離を、何度でも話します。話すたびに、ウドが細かい修正を入れます。入れる修正は、爆弾の角度です。角度を、ゾフィアが笑いながら覚えます。覚える四人は、まだ戦士ではありません。ではありません。戦士候補のまま、故郷の収容区へ戻ります。戻る先で、家族が腕章のまま待っています。待っている家族に、ガビは勝利を土産にするつもりです。
segments.en: Gabi tells, as many times as she wants, the distance she ran to the joint. Each time she tells it, Udo puts in a small correction. The correction he puts in is the angle of the bomb. Zofia remembers the angle while laughing. The four who remember are not warriors yet. They are not. Still warrior candidates, they return to the internment zone of home. At the destination of the return, their families are waiting still in armbands. Gabi intends to make the victory a gift for the families that are waiting.

segments.ja: ライナーは、車両の端でほとんど話しません。話さない顔は、四年前の同期の顔より古いです。古い顔を、候補たちは英雄の疲労だと思いたがります。たがる解釈を、本人は否定もしません。もしない沈黙の中で、彼は母の家を思っています。思っている家は、収容区の狭い部屋です。狭い部屋に、彼は鎧の成果を持って帰れません。帰れない理由は、島で失ったもののほうが大きい、です。大きい損失を、列車は聞きません。
segments.en: At the end of the car, Reiner hardly speaks. The face that does not speak is older than the face of his classmates four years ago. The candidates want to think the old face is a hero's fatigue. He himself does not deny the interpretation they want. Inside the silence of not denying it, he is thinking of his mother's house. The house he is thinking of is a narrow room in the internment zone. He cannot bring home to the narrow room a result of the Armor. The reason he cannot bring it is that what he lost on the island is larger. The train does not hear the larger loss.

segments.ja: コルトは、弟のファルコの席を確認してから、自分の報告を畳みます。畳む報告は、候補としての無難な働きです。働きを、彼はガビの爆発と比べません。比べないことが、兄の役目です。役目のまま、彼はファルコに水を渡します。渡すとき、鎧の話はしません。しない理由は、弟がガビを守るために席を狙っていることを、すでに知っている、です。知っている兄は、その狙いを今夜は褒めません。褒めない静けさが、車両の端にあります。
segments.en: After checking his younger brother Falco's seat, Colt folds his own report. The report he folds is a safe-enough performance as a candidate. He does not compare the performance to Gabi's explosion. Not comparing is the role of an older brother. Still in the role, he passes water to Falco. When he passes it, he does not talk about the Armor. The reason he does not is that he already knows his brother is aiming at the seat in order to protect Gabi. The older brother who knows does not praise that aim tonight. The quiet of not praising is at the end of the car.

segments.en: When the train approaches the internment zone, Reiner says his mother's name only once. The name he says is the name of a person who is waiting. The person of the name hopes her son comes home a hero. He himself made the expectation she hopes, four years ago. On top of the lie he ended up making, there is today's silence. His mother does not yet know the silence that is there. The lamps of the house she does not know increase beyond the window. The town that increases is Liberio's internment zone. The gate of the internment zone is lower than the gate of the battlefield. The low gate is their return.

The adults of the street hear the claim that it can, with complicated faces. Inside the faces that hear it are pride, and fear of standing out any further. segments.ja: ファルコは、ガビの後ろから家族の再会を見ます。見る再会は、温かいです。温かい光景の端で、ライナーが母の前に立つのを、彼は見逃しません。見逃さない姿勢は、英雄の姿勢ではありません。ではありません。謝る前の、曲がった背中です。背中を、母は抱きしめます。抱きしめる腕が、息子の四年を測ろうとします。測りきれない重さを、ファルコは初めて理解します。理解する重さは、点数の外側です。
segments.en: From behind Gabi, Falco watches the families meet again. The meeting he watches is warm. At the edge of the warm scene, he does not miss Reiner standing in front of his mother. The posture he does not miss is not a hero's posture. It is not. It is a bent back, before an apology. His mother embraces the back. The arms that embrace try to measure the son's four years. Falco understands for the first time the weight that cannot quite be measured. The weight he understands is outside the points.

Without knowing, Gabi starts the talk of the next inheritance. The talk she starts is that she is the closest to the Armor. Porco laughs at the close declaration through his nose. segments.en: From outside the internment zone, Magath closes the report. The wording he closes rates the candidate Gabi highly, and holds Reiner in reserve. segments.ja: 夜の遅い時間、ライナーは一人の名を小さく零します。零す名は、エレンです。エレンは、島で彼が何度も向き合った少年です。少年の記憶が、母の家の天井に重なります。重なる顔を、彼は候補たちには説明しません。説明しない理由は、説明が帰還の嘘を崩す、です。崩す前に、彼は口を閉じます。閉じた名を、ファルコは完全には聞き取れません。聞き取れない一音が、この列車の夜の底です。
segments.en: Late at night, Reiner lets one name slip, small. The name he lets slip is Eren. Eren is the boy he faced many times on the island. The memory of the boy lies over the ceiling of his mother's house. He does not explain the face that lies over it to the candidates. The reason he does not explain is that the explanation would break the lie of the return. Before it breaks, he closes his mouth. Falco cannot completely catch the closed name. The one sound he cannot catch is the bottom of this train's night.

vocab.exampleEn: At the end of the car, Reiner hardly speaks. The face that does not speak is older than the face of his classmates four years ago. The house he is thinking of is a narrow room in the internment zone. He cannot bring home to the narrow room a result of the Armor. The reason he cannot bring it is that what he lost on the island is larger. The train does not hear the larger loss.

vocab.note: The name Reiner uses for himself and Bertholdt. It is not the same as soldier.
vocab.exampleJa: 覚える四人は、まだ戦士ではありません。
vocab.exampleEn: Gabi tells, as many times as she wants, the distance she ran to the joint. Each time she tells it, Udo puts in a small correction. The correction he puts in is the angle of the bomb. Zofia remembers the angle while laughing. The four who remember are not warriors yet. They are not. Still warrior candidates, they return to the internment zone of home. At the destination of the return, their families are waiting still in armbands. Gabi intends to make the victory a gift for the families that are waiting.

vocab.exampleJa: 零す名は、エレンです。
vocab.exampleEn: Late at night, Reiner lets one name slip, small. The name he lets slip is Eren. Eren is the boy he faced many times on the island. The memory of the boy lies over the ceiling of his mother's house. He does not explain the face that lies over it to the candidates. The reason he does not explain is that the explanation would break the lie of the return. Before it breaks, he closes his mouth. Falco cannot completely catch the closed name. The one sound he cannot catch is the bottom of this train's night.
